[EN] The arrival of Thulsa's Legion scared all the animals away.

I came here to hunt what few animals were left, but now I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place.
[ES] La llegada de Thulsa's Legion ahuyentó a todos los animales.

Vine aquí a cazar los pocos animales que quedaban, pero ahora estoy entre la espada y la pared.
